item.title: Emera to Acquire Canadian Utilities for $10B
item.description: Emera and Canadian Utilities have entered into what they say is the largest merger between two Canadian companies, based on an enterprise value of around $50.47 billion.

item.title: Shell, Chevron, Oxy Issue Hurricane Isaias Updates
item.description: Shell, Chevron, and Occidental Petroleum have all issued updates in response to Hurricane Isaias.

item.title: Chevron Exits Hess Midstream as It Restructures Bakken, DJ Assets
item.description: Hess Midstream will become independent of Chevron through a swap transaction that lets Chevron keep using oil and gas gathering and processing infrastructure in the Bakken at lower cost.

item.title: Equinor raises Snøhvit Future cost forecast to $2.7bn
item.description: Equinor has lifted the investment forecast for its Snøhvit Future development in Norway to Nkr26.5bn ($2.7bn) in 2026 value, representing the third upward revision since the project was sanctioned.

item.title: Valaris secures $220m in contract awards and extensions

item.title: Syria Expects to Double Oil Output in a Year
item.description: State-owned Syria Petroleum expects oil output to increase to about 250,000 barrels a day by the end of 2027 from about 110,000 barrels a day now by investing in existing fields.
